title: Multi-Persona Dialogue Demo
description: Demonstrates multi-speaker dialogue within a single scene. Define personas with different voice profiles, then use sceneDialogue to script back-and-forth conversation. Supports host/guest/narrator roles.
script:
Welcome to today's discussion on artificial intelligence.
Let's explore what AI means for the future of creativity.

0.speaker: host
0.text: Welcome to the show. Today we're discussing AI.

0.speaker: guest
0.text: Thanks for having me. AI is transforming every industry.

0.speaker: host
0.text: What excites you most about the future?

1.speaker: host
1.text: That's a great perspective to end on.
